# netbox_wireless_lan (Data Source)

Retrieves a single wireless lan from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_wireless_lan" "example" {
  id       = 1
  group_id = 1
}

output "wireless_lan_id" {
  value = data.netbox_wireless_lan.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `auth_cipher` (String) The auth cipher of the wireless lan.
- `auth_psk` (String) The auth psk of the wireless lan.
- `auth_type` (String) The auth type of the wireless lan.
- `group_id` (Number) The ID of the group associated with the wireless lan.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the wireless lan.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the wireless lan.
- `scope_type` (String) The scope type of the wireless lan.
- `ssid` (String) The ssid of the wireless lan.
- `status` (String) The status of the wireless lan.
- `tenant_id` (Number) The ID of the tenant associated with the wireless lan.
- `vlan_id` (Number) The ID of the vlan associated with the wireless lan.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the wireless lan.
- `created` (String) When the wireless lan was created.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the wireless lan, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the wireless lan.
- `last_updated` (String) When the wireless lan was last changed.
- `scope` (String) The scope of the wireless lan.
- `scope_id` (Number) The scope id of the wireless lan.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
